verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own 'Connections' concept for evidence collection (help article on Understanding Connections) and offers a Custom Connections API for linking other systems, so connecting external systems is a first-party capability. However, the pack only shows titles: it never names a catalog covering cloud, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM or ticketing, and the only 'read-only' evidence is for the Drata device agent, not integration scopes. Missing for 10: an evidenced integrations catalog listing named connectors per category (cloud, IdP, HRIS, code hosting, MDM, ticketing), documentation of read-only OAuth/API scopes per integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting a real stack.
